replies.subject: Re: A European angle on your Biophilic Design Ideas From Lizzo’s Treehouse-Style Beverly piece
replies.body:
Hi Lisa, thanks for reaching out.

First off, it's very nice to e-meet you. Secondly, I would love to hear
more about My Villa. My current content focus is on luxury interior design,
renovation, remodeling, etc. Is there a specific topic within this scope
that Paolo would be interested in discussing? I'd love to hear any article
angles that Paolo may offer as well. In any case, let me know if there are
any ideas; if not, I will send them myself, including a few questions.
Generally, for the sake of convenience, I don't schedule calls. I'll just
send the questions and Paolo can answer them at the earliest convenience.

Very much looking forward to hearing from you soon,
Alex.

On Sat, Nov 7, 2026 at 5:08 AM Lisa Monelli <info@myvilla.la> wrote:

> Hi Alex,
>
> I just read your piece on Lizzo's treehouse-style Beverly Hills home
> and loved how you framed biophilic design as something felt, not just
> styled, especially her approach to blurring indoor and outdoor living.
>
> I'm reaching out from My Villa, an Italian studio building homes in LA
> using reinforced concrete (cemento a vista) in the tradition of
> Mediterranean architecture, where thick, textured walls have always
> worked with the landscape rather than against it to create cool,
> shaded, grounded living spaces.
>
> Would you be open to receiving some material on our approach, or
> perhaps a short call with our founder Paolo Mezzalama? No pressure
> either way, just thought it might resonate given your beat.
>
> Best,
> Lisa Monelli
> My Villa Media Team
> info@myvilla.la · myvilla.la
>


-- 
Alex Mikaelian
Content Strategist
alex.mikaelian@latimes.com
